content.text: {"steps":[{"id":"s1","description":"Use list_documents, then read candidate_specs.md and any radiation/dose or design requirement documents. Extract the three allowed absorber materials and the residual dose rate at 1 m after one week cooldown for each material; eliminate any material with dose rate > 20 uSv/h."},{"id":"s2","description":"For each dose-compliant material, run simulate_resolution at representative plate thicknesses across the allowed 2–10 mm range, e.g. 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 mm. Record each numeric resolution result with record_results."},{"id":"s3","description":"Identify the material/thickness region with the lowest simulated 100 GeV energy resolution among the compliant candidates. Around the best coarse thickness for each promising material, run additional simulations at nearby integer-mm thicknesses within 2–10 mm, recording all numeric results."},{"id":"s4","description":"If the best result is near a boundary or two options are close, run final refinement simulations at half-mm spacing around the leading thickness values, still within 2–10 mm and only for dose-compliant materials. Record all numeric results."},{"id":"s5","description":"Compare all recorded simulations while enforcing the hard dose constraint. Select the single absorber material and plate thickness with the lowest 100 GeV energy resolution among compliant options, and provide these results to the reporting module for the final recommendation."}]}

output.arguments: {"option":"Absorber-F1","plate_mm":5.5,"justification":"No fully compliant absorber can be recommended under the hard residual-dose constraint because no dose-rate data were found for any candidate and zero materials were verified to be below the 20 uSv/h limit after one week cooldown.
